Akko de Pon! - Ikasama Hourouki.name: Akko de Pon! Ikasama Hourouki
Akko de Pon! - Ikasama Hourouki.summary: Akko de Pon! Ikasama Hourouki is a mahjong game that aims to win by making full use of Ikasama skills. It's possible to use the Wii Remote to control tricks that only mahjong lovers know, such as “bukkake pulling out”, “swallowing back”, “elevator”, etc. Enjoy thrilling Ikasama mahjong that you can't taste in traditional mahjong games! It is possible to play normal mahjong that can't use squid skills.

Big Word Puzzle Book.name: Mind Body & Soul: Big Word Puzzle Book
Big Word Puzzle Book.summary:
s your brain ready for a big challenge?

Big Word Puzzle Book is a collection of letter-based puzzles, both familiar and new. Use the Nintendo DS stylus to tackle eight different teasers and, if you're ever a little stuck, a helpful hint system is on-hand. So whether it's a quick round of 'hangman' or a crafty wordsearch, there's always a fresh challenge waiting for you.

DK - Jungle Climber.name: DK: Jungle Climber
DK - Jungle Climber.summary: DK: Jungle Climber is the sequel to DK: King of Swing (2005) for the Game Boy Advance, featuring similar gameplay. However, the visuals have been designed to more closely resemble Donkey Kong Country and add dual screen support.

Easy Piano.name: Easy Piano
Easy Piano.summary: Easy Piano offers more than 40 legendary titles, playable on a real mini-keyboard designed for the Nintendo DS.

Emergency Room - Real Life Rescues.name: Emergency Room: Real Life Rescues
Emergency Room - Real Life Rescues.summary: Solve 30 medical cases with mini games.

Legend of Kay.name: Legend of Kay
Legend of Kay.summary: Legend of Kay sets out to take the player on a journey which combines classic Jump and Run elements with an immersive story driven adventure.

Touch Mechanic.name: Touch Mechanic
Touch Mechanic.summary:
Touch Mechanic takes players into the exciting world of customs and car tuning. Work your way to the top of the profession and become a surgeon of the automobile as you advance by changing rims, repairing damaged bumpers, replacing mufflers and brakes, performing paint and decal work and adding aftermarket enhancements to vehicles of all shapes and sizes.
Follow an adventurous story line and experience dozens of car modification missions. Modify your very own car with dozens of modifiable parts to create your dream ride. Work with fully rendered 3D automobiles throughout 75 levels of gameplay.

Ys II DS.name: Ys II DS
Ys II DS.summary: This is a remake of the second game in the Ys series for the DS. The game have been remade in 3D, with new music, art, and a new translation, while still keeping the feel of the older games. Also featured are touch control and local wireless multiplayer.

Yu-Gi-Oh! - World Championship 2007.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007
Yu-Gi-Oh! - World Championship 2007.summary: Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007 is a trading card oriented video game based on the Yu-Gi-Oh and Yu-Gi-Oh GX anime series'.
